title: Object participles
summary: Describe things by what someone does to them with `-DIk` and a possessive (*okuduğum kitap*, *oturduğu ev*), talk about the future with `-(y)AcAk` (*gideceğimiz yer*, *kalacak yer*), put a noun doer in the genitive (*Ali'nin okuduğu kitap*), and choose between `-(y)An` and `-DIk`.
canDo: Talk about the books, films and series you've seen and liked
Say what your favourite things are: en sevdiğim…
Find somewhere to stay and something to eat or do
Tell apart the man who saw you and the man you saw
